articles.label: § 1. Words denoting number, gender, and so forth
articles.text: In determining the meaning of any Act of Congress, unless the context indicates otherwise— words importing the singular include and apply to several persons, parties, or things;

articles.label: § 2. "County" as including "parish", and so forth
articles.text: The word "county" includes a parish, or any other equivalent subdivision of a State or Territory of the United States.

articles.label: § 5. Repealed
articles.text: Repealed. Pub. L. 99-514, title XVIII, §1899A(1), Oct. 22, 1986, 100 Stat. 2958.
